name: Blade Barrier
area: wall of whirling blades up to 20 ft. long/level, or ringed wall with radius up to 5 ft./2 levels
savingThrow: Reflex half or Reflex negates; see text
summary: Create a wall of force blades that deals up to 15d6 damage to creatures passing through it.
description: An immobile curtain of whirling force blades deals 1d6 damage per caster level (maximum 15d6) to creatures in its area, with a Reflex save for half. A creature in the wall when it appears can instead save to move to either side and take no damage. Creatures crossing the barrier thereafter take the damage with no saving throw. The wall provides cover against attacks made through it.
